roles.name: Farmer / Landowner
roles.description: Register land parcels, submit KYC identity, review carbon/water interventions, and receive direct benefit disbursements.

roles.name: Organization Admin (FPO / NGO)
roles.description: Manage assigned farmers, submit land boundaries, track project milestones, and coordinate on-ground field agent visits.

roles.name: Field Agent / Ground Surveyor
roles.description: Execute scheduled field visits, capture offline geotagged photos/measurements, and sync evidence package.

roles.name: MRV Specialist / Reviewer
roles.description: Review field evidence, validate baseline measurements, flag discrepancies, and manage MRV clarification workflows.

roles.name: Accredited Verifier (ACVA)
roles.description: BEE-accredited independent verification agency portal to review verified claims, generate audit findings, and record formal decisions.
